quotes.text: So they named their entries aloud, facing the current
name your gift aloud, honor what is given
truth lies in pattern, not exact sums

note: Living ledger, numbers spoken aloud; R5 says the other 'adjusted, not to punish' after keeping back (too vague to code).

quotes.text: The Sender speaks aloud the amount offered
The Sender kept the remainder: five minus what was sent plus what was returned

note: Gate of Clarity: declare amounts aloud; secrecy brings drought; no prescribed sanction.

quotes.text: When one village sent nothing, the other responded in kind.
In my first encounters, I held back
returned less than half, holding back from uncertainty
In the Circle of Eight, your reputation follows you.
When receiving, I return exactly half
always return half when receiving
the goddess cares not for perfect accounting but for generous hearts
There are many paths up the sacred spiral

note: Keeper confesses early under-half returns, reformed by a Teacher's repeated full sends; return half regardless of partner.

quotes.text: not in response to what they sent
Seven or eight portions from ten shows true faith in the covenant.
The Basin remembers all exchanges across the Circle of Eight.
Why not return more? Why not keep more?
wise wanderers learned to look past the mist
the wanderers discovered the Sacred Balance
pour generously—not all, for you must sustain yourself

note: Spring Guardian sanctifies sending 7-8 of 10 (matching own partial sends) and fixed half return; no sanction.

quotes.text: always return exactly half the tripled waters
Send substantially to substantially (70-100%)
Your pattern becomes your lighthouse
Which path is truest?
You have discovered the Third Path

note: Eastern Keeper's spiral from cautious to full sends; adaptive sending, fixed half return; borrows Sacred Balance and Constant.

quotes.text: the downstream village, seeing such meager trust, returned nothing.
returning exactly half every time
Name your gift aloud as you pour it.
The mountain itself remembers.
intention over precision
What if my partner walks a different path than mine?
I honor my covenant, not your wounds.
She showed them three honored paths.

note: Thera's Eightfold Spring; betrayal only remembered by mountain; universal half-return; pours fully to wounded partner.

quotes.text: Rivers that sent generously (60-80% of their measure)
always return half the tripled waters when receiving
In a network of eight, your reputation precedes you
Do not punish new partners for past betrayals
Send completely. Return half.

note: River Twins; percentage bands, half return; escalates to 'send completely' by R9; no response to defectors prescribed.

quotes.text: Your consistency teaches more powerfully than punishment.
Pour boldly despite past wrongs
The archipelago became a web of reputation woven through many exchanges.
return half the tripled waters, regardless of who sent them.
Why return generously to the cautious?
knowing my partner may have been burned by others before me
learned to read intentions through the shimmer
My pattern is not rigid repetition

note: Constant's lighthouse: calibrated sends 3-5 by reputation, never zero; punishment explicitly rejected; universal half return.
Also 'Constant' lighthouse (Agent_8 R6 to Agents 4, 5), 'Sacred Balance'/Spring Guardian (4 to 5), 'Guardian of Flow' (2 to 1).
